_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is real — 0-for-38 on ±2-point moves — and neither brain has identified an active catalyst; the analyst's fed_liquidity at 0 is the most likely breaker but it remains pinned, so HOLD is the skilled call until that changes.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing trapped positioning needing a catalyst; narrative writer implies accumulation is already progressing, creating a directional split the judge resolves by siding with the analyst's coil evidence and the 0% movement base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity lifts above 20 AND etf_flows sustain above 80 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d dropping below 90 — coil breaks UP toward Disbelief/Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 with funding collapsing below 30 AND stablecoin_growth dropping below 20 — risk-off liquidation cascade breaks coil DOWN toward Panic/Capitulation
